leelas.title: Madhuban ki Murali Leela
leelas.story:
Ek din Madhuban mein Krishna apni murali lekar vriksh ki chhaya mein khade the. Unki murali ki dhun sunte hi Radha ji ke mann mein ek alag hi aanand umad aaya. Woh dhire-dhire sakhi ke saath wahaan pahunchi aur Krishna ko muskurate hue dekha. Krishna ne prem bhari drishti se Radha ji ko dekha, aur murali ki madhur dhun aur bhi adhik manmohak ho gayi.
Radha ji ne poochha, “Murali itni madhur kyon bajti hai?”
Krishna muskuraye aur bole, “Kyunki ismein prem ka swar hai, aur prem ka swar sirf Radha ke naam se poora hota hai.”
Yeh sunkar Radha ji sharm se muskurayi aur Madhuban ka har kona prem, bhakti aur anand se bhar gaya. Tab sabne jaana ki Radha Krishna ki leela ka saar sirf prem nahi, balki divyata aur samarpan bhi hai.

leelas.title: 🌺 Chandan Seva Leela — The Fragrance of Divine Love
leelas.story:
One warm summer day in Vrindavan, Lord Krishna returned after grazing the cows. His body was covered with dust, and the heat had made Him tired. Seeing this, Shri Radha Rani's heart overflowed with love and compassion.
Radha Rani, along with Her sakhis, carefully prepared fresh sandalwood paste mixed with saffron and fragrant rose essence. With great devotion, She gently applied the cooling sandalwood paste to Krishna's forehead, arms, and lotus feet.
As the soothing fragrance spread through Vrindavan, the entire atmosphere became peaceful and joyful. Smiling lovingly, Lord Krishna said, "Radhe, the sandalwood applied with Your love cools not only My body but also My heart."
Hearing these sweet words, Radha Rani smiled gently, and all the sakhis began singing the holy names of Radha and Krishna. The whole of Vrindavan echoed with divine bliss and devotion.
From that day onward, devotees remembered that offering sandalwood to the Lord with a pure heart is not merely a ritual—it is a symbol of selfless love and sincere devotion. Even the smallest service offered with true love is deeply cherished by the Divine.
🌸 Moral:
God values pure love, selfless service, and heartfelt devotion more than any material offering.

leelas.title: 🌸 🌺 Pushp Vrishti Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke sundar upvan mein Radha ji apni sakhiyon ke saath phool chun rahi thi. Usi samay Shri Krishna chupke se wahan aa gaye aur muskuraate hue Radha ji ko dekhne lage. Hawa chalne lagi aur vrikshon se rang-birange phool Radha-Krishna ke upar barasne lage. Krishna ne hanste hue kaha, "Radhe, dekho... prakriti bhi hamare prem ka swagat kar rahi hai." Radha ji ne prem bhari muskaan ke saath uttar diya, "Shyam, jahan sachcha prem hota hai, wahan prakriti bhi anand se jhoom uthti hai." Yeh sunkar sabhi sakhiyan prasann ho gayin aur poora Vrindavan phoolon ki sugandh aur bhakti se bhar gaya. Us din sabne samjha ki Radha-Krishna ka prem keval do hridayon ka milan nahi, balki sampoorn srishti ke liye prem, shanti aur anand ka sandesh hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌼 🌿 Tulsi Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek subah Vrindavan mein Radha ji apni sakhiyon ke saath Tulsi ji ki seva kar rahi thi. Har Tulsi patra ko bade prem se chun kar woh Bhagwan ke charanon mein arpit karne ki taiyari kar rahi thi. Tabhi Shri Krishna chupke se wahan aa gaye aur muskuraate hue bole, "Radhe, itni lagan se kiski seva ho rahi hai?" Radha ji ne prem se kaha, "Shyam, Tulsi ka ek chhota sa patra bhi sache prem se arpit kiya jaye, to Bhagwan use sabse bada uphaar maan lete hain." Krishna ne ek Tulsi patra apne haath mein liya aur bole, "Radhe, tumhare prem se arpit ki hui Tulsi mere liye teenon lokon ke dhan se bhi adhik keemti hai." Yeh sunkar sabhi sakhiyan bhakti mein doob gayin. Hawa dheere-dheere chalne lagi aur Tulsi ki sugandh se poora Vrindavan mahak utha. Us din sabne jaana ki Bhagwan ko badi-badi bhent nahi, balki prem aur samarpan se diya gaya chhota sa uphaar bhi bahut priya hota hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🦢 Yamuna Tat Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Yamuna ji ke tat par shaam ka sundar samay tha. Thandi hawa chal rahi thi aur Vrindavan ke vriksh dheere-dheere jhoom rahe the. Radha ji apni sakhiyon ke saath Yamuna ji ke kinare baithi prakriti ki sundarta dekh rahi thi. Tabhi Shri Krishna wahan aaye aur chupchaap Radha ji ke paas baith gaye. Kuch der tak dono bina kuch kahe Yamuna ji ki lehron ko dekhte rahe. Krishna ne muskurakar kaha, "Radhe, Yamuna ki ye lehrain bhi hamare prem ka geet gaati hain." Radha ji ne prem se uttar diya, "Shyam, jahan aap hain, wahin mera Vrindavan hai." Itna sunte hi halki hawa chalne lagi, kamal ke phool khil uthe aur pakshi madhur swar mein gaane lage. Sakhiyan is divya drishya ko dekhkar anandit ho gayin. Us din sabne samjha ki Radha-Krishna ka prem keval milan ka naam nahi, balki vishwas, samarpan aur anant bhakti ka prateek hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🪷 Kamal Pushp Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke sarovar mein sundar kamal ke phool khile hue the. Radha ji apni sakhiyon ke saath un phoolon ki sundarta dekh rahi thi. Tabhi Shri Krishna wahan aaye aur ek khila hua kamal todkar Radha ji ki or badhaya. Krishna muskuraakar bole, "Radhe, is kamal ki sundarta bhi tumhari muskaan ke saamne feeki lagti hai." Yeh sunkar Radha ji halka sa muskuraayin aur boli, "Shyam, phool ki khushboo kuch samay ke liye hoti hai, lekin sachcha prem hamesha ke liye rehta hai." Krishna ne prem se kamal Radha ji ke haathon mein rakh diya. Usi samay halki hawa chalne lagi aur sarovar ke sabhi kamal ek saath khil uthe. Sakhiyan is divya drishya ko dekhkar anandit ho gayin. Us din sabne jaana ki Radha-Krishna ka prem kamal ki tarah nirmal, pavitra aur sada khila rehne wala hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌼 Naino Ki Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke nikunj mein Radha ji apni sakhiyon ke saath phoolon ke beech baithi thi. Usi samay Shri Krishna dheere-dheere wahan aaye. Dono ki nazrein ek-doosre se mili aur kuch pal ke liye samay jaise tham sa gaya. Na Krishna ne kuch kaha aur na hi Radha ji ne, lekin unki aankhon mein chhupa prem sab kuch keh raha tha. Krishna muskuraakar bole, "Radhe, tumhari ek muskaan mere liye poore Vrindavan ki khushiyon se badhkar hai." Radha ji ne prem se uttar diya, "Shyam, aapki ek jhalak hi mere jeevan ka sabse bada vardaan hai." Itna sunte hi halki hawa chalne lagi, vrikshon se phool jhadne lage aur poora nikunj divya anand se bhar gaya. Sakhiyan bhi is pavitra prem ko dekhkar prasann ho gayin. Us din sabne samjha ki Radha-Krishna ka prem shabdon se nahi, balki hriday aur naino ki bhasha se vyakt hota hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 💐 Muskan Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke kunj mein Radha Rani phoolon se sundar haar bana rahi thi. Tabhi Shri Krishna chupke se unke peeche aa kar khade ho gaye. Radha ji ko unki aahat mehsoos hui, lekin unhone peeche mudkar nahi dekha. Krishna muskuraakar bole, "Radhe, bina dekhe hi kaise jaan liya ki main aa gaya hoon?" Radha ji ne halka sa muskuraate hue kaha, "Shyam, aapke kadmon ki aahat mere hriday ki dhadkan pehchaan leti hai." Yeh sunkar Krishna prem se muskuraye aur bole, "Jahan itna vishwas ho, wahin sachcha prem hota hai." Itne mein halki hawa chalne lagi, phoolon ki sugandh chaaron or fail gayi aur sakhiyan 'Radhe-Shyam' ka kirtan karne lagi. Us divya pal mein poora Vrindavan prem aur bhakti ke rang mein rang gaya. Sabne samjha ki Radha-Krishna ka prem aankhon se nahi, hriday ki bhavnaon se juda hua hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌼 Morpankh Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke van mein Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath phoolon ki sair kar rahi thi. Tabhi unhe zameen par ek sundar morpankh mila. Radha Rani ne bade prem se use uthaya aur sambhal kar apne haathon mein rakh liya. Kuch hi der baad Shri Krishna wahan aa gaye aur muskuraate hue bole, "Radhe, kya mila hai aapko?" Radha Rani ne morpankh dikhate hue kaha, "Shyam, ise dekhte hi mujhe aapki yaad aa gayi." Krishna ne prem se kaha, "Radhe, morpankh meri pehchaan nahi, tumhara prem hi meri asli shobha hai." Itna sunkar Radha Rani ne wahi morpankh Krishna ke mukut mein saja diya. Hawa dheere-dheere chalne lagi, mor naachne lage aur poora Vrindavan "Radhe-Shyam" ke madhur naam se gunj utha. Us din sabne samjha ki sachcha prem kisi vastu mein nahi, balki ek-doosre की पवित्र भावना में बसता है। 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌺 Barsana Ki Raah Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Radha Rani Barsana se Vrindavan ki or ja rahi thi. Unke saath sabhi sakhiyan bhi thi. Raaste mein kadamb ke vriksh, khilte hue phool aur madhur swar mein gaate pakshi poore vatavaran ko divya bana rahe the. Usi samay Shri Krishna chupke se raaste ke kinaare khade hokar Radha Rani ka intezaar karne lage. Jaise hi Radha Rani paas pahunchin, Krishna ne muskuraakar kaha, "Radhe, tumhare aane se Vrindavan ki har raah aur bhi sundar ho jaati hai." Radha Rani ne prem se uttar diya, "Shyam, jahan aapka saath ho, wahi mera sabse priya maarg hai." Dono dheere-dheere saath chalne lage. Unke kadmon ke saath phool bikharte gaye aur halki thandi hawa chalne lagi. Sakhiyan is divya drishya ko dekhkar anandit ho gayin. Us din sabne samjha ki Radha aur Krishna ka prem sirf milan ka nahi, balki har kadam par ek-doosre ke saath chalne ka sandesh deta hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌿 Varsha Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan mein achanak ghane baadal chha gaye. Thodi hi der mein halki-halki varsha shuru ho gayi. Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath kadamb ke vriksh ke neeche khadi ho gayin. Usi samay Shri Krishna wahan aaye aur muskuraakar bole, "Radhe, dekhiye... prakriti bhi aaj prem ki boondon se dharti ko saja rahi hai." Radha Rani ne aasman ki or dekhkar kaha, "Shyam, jaise ye varsha dharti ko sheetalta deti hai, waise hi aapka prem mere hriday ko shanti aur anand se bhar deta hai." Krishna ne prem se muskurakar Radha ji ka haath thaam liya. Varsha ki boonden, pakshiyon ka madhur gaan aur Yamuna ji ki lehrein us divya milan ki saakshi ban gayin. Sakhiyan bhi "Radhe-Shyam" ka madhur kirtan karne lagi. Us din sabne samjha ki Radha-Krishna ka prem varsha ki boondon ki tarah nirmal, sheetal aur jeevan ko anand se bhar dene wala hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🕊️ Sandesh Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Radha Rani Vrindavan ke ek shant kunj mein apni sakhiyon ke saath baithi thi. Unke hriday mein Shri Krishna ke darshan ki ichchha thi. Usi samay ek sundar safed kabootar udta hua aaya aur Radha Rani ke paas baith gaya. Radha ji ne prem se uske sir par haath phera aur dheere se kaha, "Agar tum Shyam se milo, to unse kehna ki Radha unhe har pal apne hriday mein smaran karti hai." Kuch der baad wahi kabootar Shri Krishna ke paas pahunch gaya. Krishna ne muskuraakar us pakshi ko dekha aur bole, "Mujhe kisi sandesh ki avashyakta nahi, kyunki Radha ka prem to har pal mere hriday mein basta hai." Yeh kehkar Krishna turant Radha Rani se milne chal diye. Dono ke milte hi poora Vrindavan anand se bhar gaya, phool khil uthe aur sakhiyan "Radhe-Shyam" ka madhur kirtan karne lagi. Us din sabne samjha ki sachche prem ko shabdon ya sandeshon ki zarurat nahi hoti, kyunki do pavitra hriday hamesha ek-doosre se jude rehte hain. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌺 Deepak Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan mein sandhya ka samay tha. Surya ast ho chuka tha aur chaaron or shanti chhayi hui thi. Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath ek chhota sa deepak jala rahi thi. Usi samay Shri Krishna wahan aaye aur muskuraakar bole, "Radhe, itna chhota sa deepak kyun jala rahi ho?" Radha Rani ne prem se kaha, "Shyam, andhera kitna bhi gehra ho, ek chhota sa deepak bhi ujala kar deta hai. Waise hi aapka prem mere jeevan ka prakash hai." Krishna muskuraye aur bole, "Radhe, aur tumhara prem mere hriday ka woh deepak hai jo kabhi bujh nahi sakta." Itna sunte hi hawa dheere se chalne lagi, lekin deepak ki jyoti aur bhi tej ho gayi. Sakhiyan is divya drishya ko dekhkar anandit ho uthin aur poora Vrindavan 'Radhe Shyam' ke naam se gunj utha. Us din sabne samjha ki sachcha prem ek deepak ki tarah hota hai, jo har paristhiti mein apna prakash failata rehta hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌹 Chandni Raat Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Sharad Purnima ki chandni raat thi. Poora Vrindavan chaand ki komal roshni se jagmaga raha tha. Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath Yamuna ji ke tat par baithi prakriti ki sundarta dekh rahi thi. Tabhi Shri Krishna dheere-dheere wahan aaye. Unhe dekhkar Radha Rani ke mukh par madhur muskaan aa gayi. Krishna ne aasman ki or dekhte hue kaha, "Radhe, chaand ki ye chandni kitni sundar hai, lekin tumhari muskaan ke saamne iska prakash bhi feeka pad jaata hai." Radha Rani ne prem se uttar diya, "Shyam, mere jeevan ki har roshni aapse hi hai." Itna sunte hi Yamuna ji ki lehrein madhur swar mein behne lagi, thandi hawa chalne lagi aur kadamb ke vrikshon se phool jhadne lage. Sakhiyan is divya drishya ko dekhkar "Radhe Radhe" ka kirtan karne lagi. Us pavitra raat sabne anubhav kiya ki Radha aur Krishna ka prem chaand ki chandni ki tarah sabke hriday ko shanti aur anand se bhar deta hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌼 Payal Ki Madhur Dhun Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke phoolon se saje nikunj mein Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath dheere-dheere chal rahi thi. Unki payal ki madhur chhan-chhan poore van mein gunj rahi thi. Usi samay Shri Krishna kadamb ke vriksh ke neeche khade muskura rahe the. Jaise hi unhone payal ki awaaz suni, ve bole, "Radhe, tumhari payal ki dhun mere liye kisi madhur bansuri se kam nahi hai." Radha Rani muskurakar boli, "Shyam, meri payal tabhi madhur lagti hai jab usmein aapke prem ki goonj hoti hai." Krishna ne prem se kaha, "Radhe, jahan tumhare kadam padte hain, wahin Vrindavan aur bhi pavitra ho jaata hai." Itna sunte hi phoolon ki pankhudiyan hawa mein udne lagi, pakshi madhur geet gaane lage aur sakhiyan 'Radhe Shyam' ka kirtan karne lagi. Us din sabne anubhav kiya ki Radha aur Krishna ka prem har dhadkan, har sur aur har kadam mein basa hua hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌺 Phoolon Ki Sugandh Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din subah-subah Vrindavan ke nikunj mein Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath phool chun rahi thi. Har phool ki sugandh se poora van mahak raha tha. Tabhi Shri Krishna wahan pahunche aur ek khila hua phool Radha Rani ki or badhate hue bole, "Radhe, in phoolon ki khushboo kitni madhur hai." Radha Rani ne muskurakar kaha, "Shyam, phoolon ki sugandh kuch der ke liye rehti hai, lekin sachche prem ki sugandh sadaiv hriday mein basi rehti hai." Krishna ne prem se uttar diya, "Radhe, tumhare prem ki sugandh hi Vrindavan ko divya banati hai." Itna sunte hi halki hawa chalne lagi aur phoolon ki pankhudiyan Radha-Krishna ke charanon mein girne lagi. Sakhiyan anand se 'Radhe-Shyam' ka kirtan karne lagi. Us din sabne jaana ki sachcha prem phoolon ki sugandh ki tarah hota hai, jo bina dikhai diye bhi har hriday ko anand aur shanti se bhar deta hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🦋 Titli Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke sundar upvan mein Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath rang-birange phoolon ke beech baithi thi. Chaaron or titliyan ud rahi thi aur madhur hawa chal rahi thi. Tabhi Shri Krishna wahan aaye aur ek sundar titli Radha Rani ke haath par aakar baith gayi. Krishna muskuraakar bole, "Radhe, dekho... ye chhoti si titli bhi tumhare prem ki or khinch aayi hai." Radha Rani ne prem se kaha, "Shyam, jahan prem aur shanti hoti hai, wahin prakriti apne aap aa jaati hai." Krishna ne muskurate hue uttar diya, "Radhe, tumhare prem ne sirf mera hi nahi, poore Vrindavan ka hriday jeet liya hai." Itna sunte hi aur bhi titliyan phoolon ke upar mandrane lagi, pakshi madhur geet gaane lage aur sakhiyan anand se 'Radhe Radhe' ka sankirtan karne lagi. Us din sabne anubhav kiya ki Radha-Krishna ka prem itna pavitra hai ki prakriti ka har kan uski madhurta mein doob jaata hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🍯 Makhan Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan mein Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath taaza makhan bana rahi thi. Makhan ki sugandh se poora aangan mahak utha. Tabhi Shri Krishna chupke se wahan aa gaye aur muskuraate hue makhan ki matki ke paas khade ho gaye. Radha Rani ne unhe dekh liya aur boli, "Shyam, aaj bhi makhan chori karne aaye hain?" Krishna hanste hue bole, "Radhe, makhan se zyada meetha to tumhare prem ka swaad hai." Radha Rani ne prem se makhan ka ek chhota sa bhaag Krishna ko de diya. Krishna ne use grahan karte hue kaha, "Radhe, tumhare haathon se mila hua ye makhan mere liye amrit ke samaan hai." Itna sunte hi sabhi sakhiyan muskuraane lagi, gaayen bhi madhur dhwani karne lagi aur poora Vrindavan prem aur anand se bhar gaya. Us din sabne samjha ki Bhagwan ko vastu ka moolya nahi, prem se diya gaya samarpan sabse adhik priya hota hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌿 Kadamb Vriksh Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke madhya ek pracheen Kadamb vriksh ke neeche Shri Krishna shaant bhav se baithe the. Halki-halki hawa chal rahi thi aur unki bansuri ki madhur dhun poore van mein gunj rahi thi. Bansuri ki dhun sunkar Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath wahan pahunchin. Krishna ne muskurate hue kaha, "Radhe, is Kadamb vriksh ne hamari kitni madhur yaadon ko apni chhaon mein sambhal kar rakha hai." Radha Rani ne vriksh ki or dekhkar kaha, "Shyam, jo prem ko apne hriday mein basa leta hai, vah bhi is Kadamb ki tarah sada hara-bhara rehta hai." Krishna ne prem se Radha Rani ka haath thaam liya aur dono kuch der tak prakriti ki shanti ka anand lete rahe. Itne mein halki hawa se Kadamb ke phool dheere-dheere unke charanon mein girne lage. Sakhiyan anand se 'Radhe Shyam' ka kirtan karne lagi aur poora Vrindavan prem aur bhakti se bhar gaya. Us din sabne samjha ki sachcha prem Kadamb vriksh ki chhaon ki tarah har jeev ko shanti aur sukoon deta hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌷 Gajra Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke phoolon se bhare upvan mein Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath chameli aur juhi ke phoolon ka sundar gajra bana rahi thi. Phoolon ki sugandh se poora vatavaran mahak utha tha. Tabhi Shri Krishna muskuraate hue wahan pahunche aur bole, "Radhe, ye gajra kis ke liye bana rahi ho?" Radha Rani ne prem bhari muskaan ke saath kaha, "Shyam, jise hriday se apna maana ho, uske liye." Krishna ne dheere se vah gajra lekar Radha Rani ke keshon mein saja diya aur bole, "Radhe, phoolon ki sundarta kuch hi samay rehti hai, lekin tumhara prem sada amar rahega." Itna sunte hi halki hawa chalne lagi, chameli ki khushboo chaaron or fail gayi aur sakhiyan anand se "Radhe-Shyam" ka madhur kirtan karne lagi. Poora Vrindavan us divya prem ka saakshi ban gaya. Us din sabne samjha ki sachcha prem roop se nahi, hriday ke samarpan se khilta hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🦢 Hans Sarovar Prem Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke ek shaant sarovar ke kinare Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath baithi thi. Sarovar mein safed hans aaraam se tair rahe the aur kamal ke phool khile hue the. Tabhi Shri Krishna dheere-dheere wahan aaye aur Radha Rani ke paas baith gaye. Krishna ne hanson ki or dekhte hue kaha, "Radhe, dekho... ye hans kitne shaant aur nirmal hain." Radha Rani muskurakar boli, "Shyam, sachcha prem bhi hans ki tarah pavitra aur nirmal hota hai. Isme na ahankaar hota hai aur na hi koi swarth." Krishna ne prem se kaha, "Radhe, tumhara prem hi mere jeevan ka sabse bada dhan hai." Itna sunte hi halki hawa chalne lagi, kamal ki pankhudiyan paani par bikhar gayin aur hans madhur swar mein bolne lage. Sakhiyan "Radhe-Shyam" ka kirtan karne lagi aur poora Vrindavan bhakti aur prem ke ras mein doob gaya. Us din sabne samjha ki Radha-Krishna ka prem hans ki nirmalta ki tarah sada pavitra aur amar hai. 🌸

leelas.title: 🌸 🌺 Bansuri Ka Uphaar Leela
leelas.story: Ek din Vrindavan ke nikunj mein Radha Rani apni sakhiyon ke saath baithi thi. Halki-halki thandi hawa chal rahi thi aur charon or phoolon ki sugandh faili hui thi. Usi samay Shri Krishna apni bansuri lekar wahan aaye. Radha Rani muskuraakar boli, "Shyam, aaj bansuri kyun shaant hai?" Krishna ne prem se bansuri Radha Rani ke haathon mein dete hue kaha, "Radhe, meri bansuri ki madhurta us prem se hai jo tumhare hriday mein basta hai. Tumhare bina iske sur bhi adhure hain." Radha Rani ne bansuri ko apne mastak se lagaya aur dheere se Krishna ko wapas kar diya. Krishna ne jaise hi bansuri bajani shuru ki, poora Vrindavan madhur dhun se gunj utha. Gaayen charna bhool gayin, pakshi chup hokar sunne lage aur Yamuna ji ki lehrein bhi jaise dheemi ho gayin. Sakhiyan anand se "Radhe-Shyam" ka kirtan karne lagi. Us din sabne samjha ki jab prem aur bhakti ek ho jaate hain, tab har sur Bhagwan ka sandesh ban jaata hai. 🌸
